 Baguio UPLIFT beneficiaries to receive two months’ cash aid in November thru GCash
 Oct 26, 2026 7:11 PM PHT 
 Fran Cimatu Contributor
 Baguio UPLIFT 2026 
 INFO 
 The DSWD will release two months’ worth of UPLIFT cash assistance in November, with qualified Group 2 beneficiaries receiving ₱4,000 for September and October, while Group 3 SSS members will receive payments based on their monthly salary credits and previous disbursements. 
 Written by Frank Cimatu
 Qualified beneficiaries of the Department of Social Welfare and Development’s (DSWD) cash assistance program in Baguio and elsewhere will receive two months’ worth of aid in November, covering their September and October assistance, the agency said Monday, Oct. 26.
 DSWD Assistant Secretary and spokesperson Irene Dumlao said the payments under the Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food and Transport (UPLIFT) program will be released according to beneficiaries’ classifications and designated payout channels.
 Beneficiaries under Group 2, identified through the Philippine Statistics Authority’s Community-Based Monitoring System, who have registered GCash accounts, other electronic wallets or bank accounts will receive ₱4,000 on Nov. 6.
 “Beneficiaries receiving their assistance digitally will no longer need to go to an on-site payout venue. Diretso niyo na pong matatanggap sa inyong mga digital wallet at bank accounts,” Dumlao said.
 Those without registered digital wallets or bank accounts will receive the same amount through manual payouts scheduled from Nov. 2 to 30.
 The DSWD advised Group 2 beneficiaries to monitor its official Facebook accounts for announcements on their respective payout schedules and venues.
 Meanwhile, qualified Social Security System members under Group 3 will receive their assistance through their enrolled disbursement accounts.
 SSS members with a monthly salary credit of ₱10,000 will receive ₱8,000 covering the first four months of assistance beginning Oct. 30.
 Those who have already received assistance for the first two months will get the remaining ₱4,000 for the third and fourth months.
 SSS members with a monthly salary credit of ₱20,000 will receive ₱4,000 for the third and fourth tranches on Nov. 6 through their enrolled disbursement accounts.
 The DSWD did not specify the number of qualified beneficiaries in Baguio or provide a separate payout schedule for the city.
 About the author
 Frank Cimatu is a veteran poet and journalist based in Baguio City. He currently contributes to Rappler and co-runs the Facebook page Mountain Beacon. In 2018 and 2021, he published two poetry collections: Ang Mga Prusisyong Dumaan Sa Unang Bangungot and Birdcatching in Sagada and Other Poems. Prusisyon won the 20th Madrigal-Gonzales Best First Book Award for 2021. He twice won the Palanca for poetry in English and Filipino. He also placed 2nd in the Procyon Awards for Young Filipino Poets. His current collection is a compilation of his works from the onset of the pandemic to the present, following his recollections of nostalgia, pop culture, and political response to the struggles faced by journalists brought by red-tagging.
